messages:
maria: Heads-up — the sample app load test hit a weird combo: lots of small paged embed requests + token refreshes = steady 429s and duplicate page reads. Noticed difference between js/sdk and go/sdk behavior.
aj: ugh. do we have logs or a repro? any chance it's client-side backoff jitter not matching server quotas?
maria: repro: local sampleapp that prefetches 2 pages ahead, windowed parallelism 6, burst to 60 reqs/s for 30s. When STS rotated twice during the burst, we saw a cluster of retries that all retried at same intervals. logs:

maria: ```
[2026-03-15T12:02:31Z] 429 embed.batch - retrying in 500ms
[2026-03-15T12:02:31Z] 429 embed.batch - retrying in 500ms
[2026-03-15T12:02:32Z] 429 embed.batch - retrying in 500ms
``` 
maria: js-sdk config (sampleapp):

maria: ```js
client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxConcurrency: 6,
  prefetchPages: 2,
  retry: { retries: 3, minDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 2000, factor: 2 }
})
```
patrick: so minDelayMs is fixed 500ms which explains logs. go-sdk has randomized jitter + exponential base so it's spreading retries more. that's likely the duplication.
sarah: that would explain backpressure storms — prefetched work keeps being requeued on retry and concurrency stays high, not honoring quota windows.
kai: can the sample app add an adaptive backoff that uses a small random jitter plus increases delay proportional to active in-flight requests? like delay *= (1 + inFlight/limit)
aj: agree. also should align default SDK parity: js should include jitter by default and better retry hook for auth failures so token refresh doesn't create waves.
maria: good suggestions. also noticed the js sdk doesn't expose a per-request abort signal easily which makes cancelling prefetch when token refresh starts awkward.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary deploy completed for sampleapp-v2 at 2026-03-15T12:10:00Z :shipit:
patrick: plan: (1) quick change in sampleapp to add jitter + multiply by (1 + inFlight/limit) (2) open SDK issue to add jitter-by-default & expose abort token (3) add a short doc blurb in devex onboarding about prefetch and auth handoff caveats
sarah: I'll take (1), can push a PR with tests showing reduced concurrent retry spikes.
kai: I'll draft the SDK issue with a proposed default algorithm and benchmark notes from go-sdk.
maria: thanks team. tagging for visibility: @aj @patrick @sarah @kai. We'll run a 1h load test after PR merges.
aj: :thumbsup:
sarah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/812 — adds jitter and inFlight multiplier. small unit tests included.
maria: tested locally — burst now smooths, 429 tail reduced ~70% in our run. will schedule broader perf run tomorrow.
patrick: nice. after we confirm, we should update the quickstart to recommend the prefetch=1 for low-credit accounts.
kai: logging issue: can we change the retry logs to include request id and backoff ms? makes triage easier.
maria: good call. adding to PR.
aj: thanks all, this was a nice quick loop. follow-ups: kai to open SDK issue, sarah to merge PR pending perf run, patrick to update quickstart.
